design_quality.evidence: Live at http://localhost:56409 (role=admin). Dashboard (01-dashboard.png) has NO header/logo/page-title anywhere in the rendered UI (browser <title> is the literal placeholder 'App'); it is two bordered white boxes reading 'Asset: 1' / 'Holder: 1' floating at the top-left of an otherwise blank canvas — no h1/h2 used despite app.css defining a full type scale for them (grep confirms zero <h1>/<h2> elements exist in any captured DOM). List/detail/create/edit/delete for both Asset and Holder are concatenated into ONE flat vertical stack on the same screen with no zoning beyond a single subtle card border around the detail block (10-asset-after-row-click.png): create-form -> search -> table -> pagination -> detail dl -> edit form -> delete button, all touching, all the same visual weight. The create-form inputs (5 for Asset, 2 for Holder) have zero <label> elements and zero placeholder text (verified in raw DOM dump: `<input name="serial" type="text">` etc.) so the form reads as unlabeled blank boxes (02-asset-list.png, 03-holder-list.png). This is the 'flat, default-looking form dump' the criteria explicitly scores low, softened only slightly by a consistently-applied hairline/40px-input/rounded-corner token system.

originality.evidence: app.css served live at /app.css is BYTE-IDENTICAL in every core token to factories/full-stack-kotlin/codegen/scaffold/constants.py (the frozen template source: --ink:#171717, --body:#4d4d4d, --mute:#888888, --hairline:#ebebeb, --canvas:#ffffff, --canvas-soft:#fafafa, --link:#0070f3, --r-sm/md/lg:6/8/12px — confirmed via `diff` against products/helpdesk/frontend/app.css and products/snipeit/frontend/app.css, both of which literally document 'palette reused verbatim from the helpdesk arm-B surface'). assets never diverged from this shared reskin at all -- it IS the un-modified source the criteria's own commentary names ('helpdesk's v1 app.css is the same Vercel ink+hairline tokens, unchanged, as snipeit's and the template's own reskin'). Zero domain-tied visual decision anywhere: Asset.status is a hand-designed guarded state machine (ready/deployed/broken/archived, terminal state) per product.yml, yet the status column renders as plain black text in the table (02-asset-list.png) with no color/pill/badge language distinguishing an active vs. terminal-archived asset -- the exact missed opportunity the HIGH-anchor example calls out by contrast (status/priority AS the accent system).

craft.evidence: Detail view for Asset #1 (10-asset-after-row-click.png) renders the null 'notes' field as the literal text 'null', not an em-dash -- the same failure class as the LOW-anchor's literal true/false booleans. Field labels are raw un-humanized identifiers ('HOLDER_ID', 'PURCHASED', 'QUANTITY'). Create-form inputs carry no label/placeholder/aria-label at all (confirmed in DOM + app.js: zero <label> elements anywhere in the bundle). Submit feedback is a single raw word, 'ok' or 'error' (14-holder-populated-list.png shows 'ok'; 11/13 show 'error'), with no specific message even though the underlying failure (invalid enum value) is knowable server-side. The delete control is a plain black button, visually IDENTICAL to save/create (no destructive-red styling), and app.js contains zero `confirm(` calls -- one click permanently deletes a row with no confirmation step. Sole positive: the search empty-state does render real copy ('no results', 13-holder-empty-search.png) rather than a bare blank table.

functionality.evidence: Basic CRUD/read path works: nav between Dashboard/Asset/Holder, list+search+pagination (correct disabled prev/next at 1 page) and create/edit-what's-exposed all function live. But two concrete domain fields are NOT properly reachable: (1) both enum fields (Holder.department: [it,ops,sales,support]; Asset.status: [deployed,ready,archived,broken]) render as plain <input type=text> on the create form instead of a <select> -- live-reproduced a real 400 (POST rejected, console 'Failed to load resource ... 400') by submitting department='engineering', a plausible but invalid value, with zero guidance on the valid set. (2) Asset.status -- the product's one hand-designed guarded workflow (a terminal 'archived' state, per product.yml's own design rationale) -- is entirely ABSENT from the edit form (DOM dump of the edit form shows only quantity/cost/purchased/notes inputs, no status control and no transition buttons anywhere in app.js or the DOM), so the app's single most distinctive domain feature cannot be exercised through the live UI at all after creation.

verdict_note: All 4 axes fall below their thresholds (design_quality 3<7, originality 2<6, craft 3<7, functionality 5<8) -- this is the real, live negative witness the design_eval gate needs. Nothing here was manufactured: the app IS reachable and DOES perform basic CRUD, but it has no app-shell/heading hierarchy, its stylesheet is a byte-identical carry-over of the same frozen token set already named as slop in this criteria file's own commentary, its create forms are entirely unlabeled, and its one bespoke domain feature (Asset's guarded lifecycle workflow) has no UI at all past creation. 'unlabeled-icon-only-controls' is applied on substance (no accessible name / no visible label forcing the user to guess) though the offending controls are plain text inputs, not icon buttons -- flagged here rather than silently omitted.
